notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one presses B2 on the MR128's outside diameter and slips the four rod holes (H1) on the all-thread. The 2D section the body is extruded from is gated separately in render.rs --verify, and the dimensions and fits are in 420-002_EndArmHubCap.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
